trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh (H.M.A. No.123 of 2024)
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 10.04.2016. Out of the wedlock till date, there is one girl child, i.e., Ankita who is residing with the petitioner. Parties cohabited till October, 2020, when the petitioner was turned out of the matrimonial home by the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The court have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood.
cited_cases: N.C. V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, (2022) SCC OnLine SC 1199

legal_principles.principle: When two or more proceedings are pending in different Courts between the same parties which raise common question of fact and law, and when the decisions in the cases are interdependent, it is desirable that they should be tried together by the same Judge.
legal_principles.held: It is desirable that they should be tried together by the same Judge so as to avoid multiplicity in trial of the same issues and conflict of decisions.
cited_cases: N.C. V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, (2022) SCC OnLine SC 1199

outcome.final_order: Petition filed under Section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code seeking transfer of the petition filed by the respondent under Section 13(1)(IA)(IB) of the Hindu Marriage Act to the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Solan, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh.

keywords: Solomon's maxim: 'Cutting off the branch on which one sits'
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of divorce case
advising client on options for resolving marital disputes
preparing a response to a petition under Section 13(1)(IA)(IB)
